title: Assessing Out-of-Domain Language Model Performance from Few Examples

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model reliance on shallow reasoning shortcuts and pathological heuristics (e.g., lexical overlap, subsequence matching, surface features) using token-level feature attributions (LIME, SHAP, Integrated Gradients) on few-shot out-of-domain examples from datasets like HANS, PAWS, and MSGS.
